profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SpaceX
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at SpaceX
- Maintaining a C++ Physics/Software Simulator 
- Using Bazel to support a large repo used by hundreds of engineers
- Aspiring software leader

Education
- BS Computer Science, 2021, Magna Cum Laude
- BS Mechanical Engineering, 2021, Magna Cum Laude
- Main expertise: C++, Python, Bazel

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on simulation software that simulates the various missions across every vehicle at SpaceX. Focusing on the models as well as the testing and infrastructure around the software suite

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Teaching ENME350: Electronics and Instrumentation I
• Gaining deep understanding of electrical systems and circuit components

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:

• Taught Matlab / C++

positions.title: President
positions.description:
• Oversaw fraternity growth from less than 40 to nearly 100 engineering / CS undergraduates, budget >$40,000
• Coordinated fraternity’s entrance into Maryland IFC, gaining school recognition
